cards.front: A scaphoid abdomen and chest lucency in a newborn represent herniated [___], not pleural air.
cards.context: Needling that lucency can injure the bowel and does not recruit lung. The lethal problem is pulmonary hypoplasia and pulmonary hypertension. The CDH EURO Consortium consensus describes this.

cards.front: In Hirschsprung disease the dilated proximal colon is the [___] segment.
cards.context: The narrow segment is the aganglionic obstruction. The dilated bowel above it still has ganglia and is the bowel that is working.
